title: Elegant Wedding Invitation (Ideogram)
description: Wedding invitation design with floral elements and elegant typography. Suitable for wedding planners and stationery designers.

prompt.main: elegant wedding invitation card, soft watercolor eucalyptus wreath border, blush pink and sage green palette, central text reading "Emma & James" in elegant script, smaller text "June 15 2024" below, fine paper texture, save the date --ar 5:7
prompt.negative: cheap, modern, busy, bright colors, cartoon

tutorial.intro: Wedding invitations need names + date + script typography + soft palette + botanical accent. The five-element rule.
steps: Format: elegant wedding invitation card, save the date — format.
Botanical: soft watercolor eucalyptus wreath border — single plant type + wreath layout.
Palette: blush pink and sage green palette — two named muted colors.
Names: central text reading "Emma & James" in elegant script — actual names in quotes.
Date: smaller text "June 15 2024" below — date in quotes.
Material: fine paper texture — paper grain cue.
tutorial.tips: Wedding = soft palette + script + botanical + names in quotes. Ideogram renders the names perfectly.

crossModel.midjourney: MJ v6.1: "wedding invitation, Emma & James, eucalyptus wreath --ar 5:7 --v 6.1 --s 600".
crossModel.stable_diffusion: SDXL with controlnet. Use Ideogram for text.
crossModel.flux: Flux is OK. Ideogram best for text.
crossModel.dall_e: DALL-E 3: "An elegant wedding invitation with the text Emma & James, June 15 2024, surrounded by a watercolor eucalyptus wreath".
crossModel.jimeng_zh: 优雅婚礼请柬，水彩桉树叶花环，文字 "Emma & James"，2024 年 6 月 15 日。

faq.a: Use Ideogram for wedding stationery. Other models ruin names with kerning errors.
"Fine paper texture" + "soft watercolor" + muted palette. These three = premium stationery.
Two soft colors only. Pink+green, blue+gold, lavender+cream. Avoid high contrast.
